Title: Ajay's Day

Cast

1. Ajay - 32 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 59 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Pallavi - 25 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Rajesh - 31 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ajay stands in the living room. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ajay pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Ajay: "I'm ready!"

[Ajay sips red wine.]

Ajay (softly): "And then?"

[Ajay staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Ajay: "That was such a fun day!"
